title: DataTable page performance hardening
reported_symptom: Entire DataTable lab page feels heavy/laggy during normal page scrolling; not primarily a grid-scroll complaint.
corrected_root_cause: four concurrent AG Grid instances mounted on initial /data render
server simulation initiated its intentional 180ms request during page entry
sticky blurred lab control surface composited above complex grid layers
implemented: initial /data AG Grid count reduced from four to one
editable/server/master-detail grids mount exactly once on explicit request
deferred grids inherit current persisted lab density
DataTable-route lab control bar uses opaque elevated surface with no backdrop blur
browser gate measures initial grid count, page-scroll frame latency and deferred-grid completeness
RC3 no-debounce/10-row-buffer settings retained as safe virtualization defaults
